prime_gates.evidence_needed: Exact bidding legal entity and Arkansas foreign-corporation authority analysis if applicable.
At least three current continental-US customers relevant to requested services, with permission/contact details for proposal.
Current higher-ed references, if any; preferred/scored, not mandatory minimum.
Certificate(s) proving RFP Section 11 workers comp/employer liability, CGL and auto limits.
Provable similar CMMC/security-compliance engagements; no invented project or outcome.
Named staff resumes/qualifications/certifications exactly as proposed and supportable.
Person authorized to bind bidding entity.
UA Formal Bid Submission access/process verified by owner.
Owner-approved fixed/optional service prices valid 120 days.
Owner review and completion evidence for current counterpart forms and requirements R21-R23; see source_ledger.json for named forms and unresolved clauses.

teaming_gates.evidence_needed: One credible prime with CMMC program delivery and institutional reference fit.
Written partner acceptance that it owns buyer relationship, proposal, references, insurance, signature and prime obligations. Include allocation of recovered counterpart requirements R21-R23.
Primary evidence for partner capability and no fleet/provider duplicate outreach.
Partner workshare carrier merged and current.
Internal $35k target remains hypothesis until owner/partner approval.

truth_boundary: Unknown is not false and is never PASS. Fill only with evidence the owner can actually produce.
intake_convention: current_candidate.json records only evidenced readiness: false and reference counts of zero mean no supporting evidence is retained, not a negative claim about the owner. UNKNOWN and OPEN states remain unresolved.
